lines.text: Amazon just launched a gadget that listens to your day and remembers it for you.
On October 15, Amazon's Bee revealed two new AI devices: Bee Frontier and Bee Eclipse.
Frontier costs $74.99. Wear it on your wrist or clip it on. It's water resistant, with up to 7 days of battery.
Eclipse is a $99.99 card that snaps onto your phone, with over 21 days of battery. It's coming soon.
Both record your conversations and turn them into summaries, to-dos and reminders.
Amazon says audio is deleted after processing, and transcripts are encrypted with keys on your device.
The free plan remembers 14 days. Bee Pro costs $11.99 a month.
Why it matters: AI that remembers your day is here. But people nearby may not know they're being recorded.
